title: Спорт и моя жизнь
subtitle: Sport & my life
prompt: Your Russian-speaking friend wants to know how you stay physically active. Write a message describing activities you enjoy. Explain when you do them, who you do them with, and why you enjoy them.
independentPrompt: A Russian-speaking friend is visiting you next weekend. Write a message describing an active day you would like to spend together. Include what you want to do, when and where, and why you enjoy these activities. Ask your friend a question.
sample: Я люблю играть в теннис. Мы иногда играем с подругами после школы. Мне нравится, потому что весело. Ещё я люблю гулять с собакой.

story.explanation: Tennis is an example of an activity you enjoy.
This adds another activity, rather than a later event.

grammar.explanation: С means ‘with’ here and takes the instrumental case. The words for ‘my’ and ‘friend’ agree: с моей подругой.

grammar.error: Я играю в теннис после школа.
grammar.answer: Я играю в теннис после школы.
grammar.explanation: После (‘after’) takes the genitive case: школа → после школы.

demoFeedback.summary: This is an illustrative feedback example for the sample sports message. It does not evaluate your saved writing.

dimensions.name: Prompt completion
dimensions.detail: The sample names activities, when, with whom, and why. It could add a place.

dimensions.name: Comprehensibility
dimensions.detail: A reader can understand the activities in the sample.

dimensions.name: Sentence development
dimensions.detail: The sample includes a reason with потому что. A more specific reason would add meaning.

dimensions.name: Organization
dimensions.detail: Ещё connects a second activity. Related details could stay together.

dimensions.name: Language accuracy
dimensions.detail: The sample’s с подругами and после школы show useful case patterns.

strengths: The sample communicates personal activities in original sentences.
It gives both a time and a reason.
nextSteps: In your own response, check that the reader knows where an activity happens.
Add a specific reason and a question to your friend.

issues.message: The sample could give a more specific reason.
